description:
Set within one of Wexford’s most desirable modern developments, this impressive home in Manor View enjoys an enviable elevated position with
stunning coastal views stretching towards Wexford Bay and Rosslare  Harbour.  The development is renowned for its contemporary design, 
excellent energy performance and beautifully maintained surroundings.   From the front of the property, the elevated aspect provides panoramic 
coastal and harbour views, while the location places residents just  moments from Wexford Town Centre, bus routes, schools, shops and major 
road connections. It is a setting that combines convenience, lifestyle and  scenery exceptionally well.  Internally, the property is beautifully presented, with a stylish and tastefully decorated interior creating a warm, elegant and welcoming atmosphere throughout. The accommodation is spacious, well proportioned and  thoughtfully laid out, with a natural flow between the living spaces.  A warm entrance hallway with carpeted staircase leads to a versatile ground-floor room, which could be ideally suited as a fourth bedroom, playroom, home office or gym.  The bright and comfortable living room  features double doors opening into a generous kitchen/dining area. The contemporary kitchen is a particular highlight, with a central island/breakfast bar providing an ideal space for casual dining, food reparation and entertaining. A useful storage cupboard offers excellent  additional space for a mini pantry, while French doors open directly onto the patio and large rear garden.  The rear garden is a superb feature of the property, offering excellent privacy, a generous outdoor space and the benefit of not being directly overlooked. A utility room and guest WC complete the ground floor, while a rear door provides convenient access to the garden.  Upstairs, the well-proportioned landing features a useful storage cupboard and stair access to the attic. The master bedroom benefits from its own ensuite, while two further double bedrooms enjoy beautiful coastal views. A family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.   Externally, the property benefits from a smart front garden, private parking for two cars and a gated side entrance providing convenient access to the  rear garden.  This is a superb opportunity to acquire a beautiful, modern and exceptionally well-presented home in a highly sought-after residential setting, combining tasteful interiors, flexible living accommodation, outstanding coastal views, excellent outdoor space and superb convenience.
